art_style: Geometric, one-color-first vector-compatible construction with clear negative space

combination mark.reason: Full product name and recognizable compact mark are useful on GitHub and docs.

abstract mark.reason: Checkpoint and ledger concepts can be conveyed without letters.

lettermark.reason: VIB is the established short name; short text suits compact surfaces.

mascot.reason: Adds personality but obscures engineering purpose at small sizes.

concepts.art_style: Geometric, one-color-first, cut negative space; restrained angular corners
concepts.example: Three offset horizontal checkpoint bars joined by a vertical spine. The final bar stops short to leave a visible owner-decision gap. Pair with the letters VIB.
concepts.rationale: Brand fit 5: numbered checkpoints and durable handoff. Character 4: deliberate proportions and negative space. Distinctiveness 4: avoid generic checkmark, branch or shield. Versatility 5: compact one-color construction; test at 24 px.

concepts.art_style: Geometric folded bands, no gradients, solid silhouette
concepts.example: Two opposing folded bands frame a narrow central ledger slit. Three notches along one edge suggest recorded issue history.
concepts.rationale: Brand fit 4: ledger and persistence, less explicit workflow. Character 4: physical fold motif. Distinctiveness 4: avoid book/document icon. Versatility 4: internal notches could disappear below 24 px.

concepts.art_style: Custom monoline-inspired solid letter construction; compact, optically balanced
concepts.example: Interlocking V and I built from one uninterrupted rectangular ribbon with a separated terminal block implying B and the next checkpoint.
concepts.rationale: Brand fit 4: recognizable acronym, weaker evidence meaning. Character 5: custom lettering can provide identity. Distinctiveness 3: crowded V-letter mark category. Versatility 4: small-size readability needs testing.

selection_reason: Proposed lead 90/100 vs 80/100 for each alternative; clearest connection to durable numbered checkpoints and smallest surface. Not owner-approved. No artwork until exact name confirmation.
